text:
Nora (Partnerships): FYI EdgeBox reported a bunch of negative deltas after their nightly replay. They want an expedited credits plan and a change to the acknowledgement flow. Thoughts?
Tom (Partner Eng): their replay logic replays tombstones later than initial ingest, causing our windowed dedupe to subtract events. they want either a backfill-safe mode or a guaranteed-timestamp watermark so replays are additive.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): we currently dedupe by (event_id, source_shard) within a 24h window + running watermark per partner. late tombstones older than the watermark are applied as deletes. we can change to tombstone-tagging so backfill replays can be handled as "backfill=true" and go through a separate idempotent path.
Camila (Billing): for credits we need a deterministic reconciliation path. prefer a single-origin-of-truth replay that produces a reconciliation bundle (replay.json) with before/after usage and checksums. billing will only issue credits after verifying that bundle.
Priya (Revenue Ops): customers hate invoice noise. could we implement credit smoothing: small net-negative adjustments under $250 get auto-credited to next invoice without full audit. larger claims trigger manual review.
Tom (Partner Eng): EdgeBox will accept smoothing but wants visibility (per-customer delta report) and a limit on how often smoothing applies.
Nora (Partnerships): sounds reasonable. Policy draft: auto-credit threshold $250 per account, max 3 smooth credits per quarter, full audit available on request within 60 days.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): implementation notes: add a "replay_type" field on ingest: replay_type={live,backfill,correction}. Backfill and correction go to the reconciliation pipeline, which keeps raw records for 60 days. We'll also produce a signed reconciliation bundle: {"customer_id":..., "period":..., "pre": {token_counts}, "post": {...}, "checksum": "sha256:..."}.
Camila (Billing): require signed bundle + partner-provided observed-file to accept a credit. Also require claim filed within 45 days of the invoice.
Priya (Revenue Ops): can we add a throttled "ack-receipt" webhook that partners call with their sequence high-watermark? That would let them see if any events were dropped before invoice generation.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): yes, we can expose the ack webhook. example:
```
POST https://api.redwood.com/partners/edgebox/ack-receipt
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <partner-key>
Body: {"shard":"s-12","high_watermark":98765432,"seq":12345}
```
ops-bot: "note: public partner endpoints must include rate-limit 60/min and require mTLS or signed tokens"
Tom (Partner Eng): EdgeBox asks if we can optionally produce a rolling "delta stream" they can subscribe to for near-real-time deviations per customer so they can correct before close.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): we can offer delta-stream as an enterprise add-on (Kafka topic per partner, retention 7d, ACLed). Costs apply.
Camila (Billing): for delta-stream clients we can offer shorter dispute windows (30d) and faster reconciliations. Add that to pricing sheet.
Nora (Partnerships): legal check: any language for limitations of liability for replay-caused adjustments?
Priya (Revenue Ops): typical clause: credits limited to invoiced usage amounts, no consequential damages, and partner must follow replay + proof workflow. Legal to finalize.
Nora (Partnerships): action items: Priya draft credit-smoothing policy, Camila draft reconciliation checklist and bundle spec, Ravi spin up ack-receipt API PR + replay_type flags, Tom coordinate EdgeBox repro and opt-in for delta-stream. Deadline Wed COB?
Ravi (Eng-Platform): ok PRs by Wed. will include sample reconciliation bundle generator code in repo.
Camila (Billing): will include sample CSV format and checksum instructions.
Tom (Partner Eng): I'll get EdgeBox to run a small tombstone backfill and send logs to us for the first repro.
ops-bot: "task created: #PR-5120 (ack-receipt-api), #DOC-804 (reconciliation-bundle-spec), #POL-120 (credit-smoothing-policy)"
Priya (Revenue Ops): small ask: include a maximum quarterly cap on credits per partner to control abuse. propose $25k/mo or 5% of monthly ARR, whichever is smaller.
Nora (Partnerships): agreed, put it in the policy draft as a configurable commercial term.
Ravi (Eng-Platform): last technical note: when we generate reconciliation bundles, include event provenance: original_timestamp, ingest_timestamp, replay_tag, and a signature over the bundle. That way disputes are auditable.
Camila (Billing): and include a human-readable summary page so finance doesn't need to parse raw JSON.
Tom (Partner Eng): EdgeBox also requested a sandbox where they can run replays against a shadow billing engine. we can give them a test partner id tied to staging.
Nora (Partnerships): good call. add sandbox access to the onboarding checklist for partners doing large replays.
ops-bot: "thread closed: reconciliation-policy-draft-started"
